text:
Ava (Marketing PM): OK team — goal for today: finalize landing hero + CTAs for Hosted / Dedicated / Private, and pin conversion routing + webinar promo copy. Quick sync? :wave:
Sam (Content): here. can we keep hero short — benefit first. 3 lines max per variant.
Priya (Design): thumbs up. we can show tri-column hero on desktop, stacked on mobile. will mock by EOD. :art: 
Rohan (Growth): routing notes: we need deterministic UTM+path mapping so leads go to proper funnels. also propose a single webinar CTA for awareness, separate demo/contact CTAs for Dedicated/Private.
Marta (SEO): add one line for keywords: "low-latency inference", "dedicated GPU inference", "private deployment" — keep natural.
Sam (Content): draft starters:
- Hosted: "Start building with our Hosted API — production-grade LLM inference in minutes."
- Dedicated: "Reserved GPU capacity for consistent throughput and SLAs."
- Private: "Deploy in your VPC or on-prem for compliance-sensitive workloads."
Liam (Analytics): conversion routing proposal below. we'll track utm_medium=web, utm_campaign=tri-hero.
Rohan (Growth): please use this mapping (to be implemented by eng/marketing infra):
```
/path?mode=hosted -> funnel=self-serve&utm_campaign=tri-hero
/path?mode=dedicated -> funnel=sales-psr&utm_campaign=tri-hero
/path?mode=private -> funnel=enterprise-ae&utm_campaign=tri-hero
/button?cta=webinar -> funnel=webinar_registrations&utm_campaign=tri-hero
```
Priya (Design): can we show a small secondary row with "Compare modes" link that opens a modal? CTA order: Primary (hosted/dedicated/private) + Secondary (compare + webinar)
Ava (Marketing PM): For the webinar promo copy, draft headline + 1-liner + CTA text. Sam, wanna run speakers + angle?
Sam (Content): headline: "Choosing the right inference strategy: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private"; 1-liner: "Live panel + benchmarks — pick the deployment that cuts latency and cost for your app." CTA: "Reserve my seat" or short "Register".
Marta (SEO): include alt copy for images: "Redwood inference hosted api dashboard" etc. small point but helps.
Liam (Analytics): also adding micro-conversion: Webinar RSVP goes into nurture with tag 'tri-hero-webinar'. Sales leads get 'dedicated-interest' or 'private-interest'.
Jules (Sales AE): quick ask — when someone hits dedicated/contact, add a required field: team size + expected qps. helps qualify earlier.
Rohan (Growth): agree. also propose progressive capture on self-serve signup for hosted: just email first, follow up in-app for usage.
Priya (Design): uploading 3 mock variants to Figma: https://figma.com/file/abcdef/tri-hero
Ava (Marketing PM): Nice. Sam/SEO — finalize copy for each hero and 2 subhead variations. Sam can we do A/B: performance-driven vs cost-driven headlines?
Sam (Content): yes. sample A/B:
A: "Ship LLM features faster — API-first hosted inference"
B: "Lower per-token cost with intelligent batching and caching"
Priya (Design): good. also test CTA label: "Get started" vs "Request demo" (for dedicated/private)
Liam (Analytics): will set up experiment in GA/Amplitude. need final variants by tomorrow 10am.
Ava (Marketing PM): action items:
- Sam: finalize 3 hero headlines + 2 subheads each (due: tomorrow 9am)
- Priya: Figma mock + responsive spec (due: tomorrow 5pm)
- Rohan & Liam: implement CTA routing config + tracking (due: Thurs)
- Jules: define qualification fields for sales form (due: Thurs)
- Marta: SEO alt text + meta suggestions (due: Thurs)
- Dev infra: please accept mapping and add redirects. @deploy-bot can you post once config is deployed?
DeployBot: deploy scheduled — config branch "marketing/tri-hero-routing" tested in staging. CI green. :rocket:
Priya (Design): small note — use system icons for "latency" "cost" "security" under each variant.
Sam (Content): I'll also prepare a short launch post (blog + social) that ties to the webinar bench results. draft will include 2 bench highlights: 30% cost reduction with caching, 20% end-to-end latency improvement on typical chat loads.
Ava (Marketing PM): perfect. let's keep comments here short. posting mocks & copy drafts in the thread as they come. :sparkles:
